provenance.title: 1. Monetary Regime: The Oct 2025 Inflation Halving & Daily Burn Offset
provenance.plainSentence: The October 2025 governance cutover halved annualized NEAR supply expansion from ~5.0% to ~2.50%, while L1 gas burn (~1,080 NEAR/day) still offsets ~1.2% of gross issuance.
provenance.methodology: 30-day rolling annualized change in total_supply aligned with protocol_config.max_inflation_rate [1, 40] and daily gas_fee burn.

provenance.title: 2. Simpson’s Paradox Audit: Pooled 703d Illusion vs. Post-Migration 90d Coupling
provenance.plainSentence: Pooled all-time history suggests Intents and NEAR L1 decoupled (r = -0.67), whereas the recent 90-day cohort reveals positive transaction coupling (r = +0.41) even though dollar gas burn remains small.
provenance.methodology: Paired Pearson & Spearman correlations sliced across 30d, 90d, 180d, and full matched DefiLlama/NEARBlocks history plus 30-day rolling correlation.

provenance.title: 3. The Fee Inversion: Intents Protocol Fee Pool vs. NEAR L1 Base Gas Burn
provenance.plainSentence: NEAR Intents processes billions in monthly cross-chain swap flow at ~16 bps blended fees ($6.05M/30d), dwarfing L1 base fee revenue (~$131K/30d) by roughly 46x without automated buyback routing.
provenance.methodology: Cumulative and daily time series comparing Intents swap fees (DefiLlama totalDataChart) against NEAR L1 txn_fee_usd.

provenance.title: 4. Multi-Chain Valuation & Turnover Peer Matrix
provenance.plainSentence: NEAR sits near the bottom of peer L1s in raw TVL ($165M) yet leads peers in 24h DEX turnover/TVL (>100%), proving execution velocity outpaces idle capital.
provenance.methodology: Cross-chain snapshot normalized to TVL, stablecoin float, annualized 30d fees/revenue, and 24h DEX turnover.

provenance.title: 5. Non-Tax Storage Lockups, Validator Nakamoto Decentralization & Live Quotes
provenance.plainSentence: intents.near permanently locks over 136k NEAR via on-chain state staking while validator decentralization holds at Nakamoto33=10, grounding real capital utility.
provenance.methodology: Direct RPC view_account state bytes * storage_amount_per_byte + live validator stake distribution + live unauthenticated dry quotes on 1Click.
